topic.title: DocBook Checker Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The DocBook Checker add-on validates DocBook files and reports detected issues.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
body.p: The DocBook Checker add-on reports issues such as broken internal and external links, problems with images, or profiling conditions that conflict with profiling preferences.
